_comment: Synthetic examples of the runtime state file. The real file lives at $JEV_STATE_DIR/mode.json. Example 1 is the shadow-only mode used in production.

example_auto_lease._comment: auto additionally requires JEV_AUTO_APPROVED; an expired auto_until or a heartbeat older than 120s degrades to shadow.

example_tripped._comment: Shape a circuit breaker would write after N consecutive routing failures. Clearing it is an explicit operator action.
